proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Gus arrived at 7:58, walked my list of nine items with me, and had everything done by 11:50. Two patches, a sticking bedroom door, a new bathroom faucet and five pictures hung level. He showed me each one before he packed up.
reviews.name: Laura B.

reviews.text: Our inspection report had fourteen small items and we closed in eighteen days. They cleared all of them in one full day and sent photos of every fix to our agent that evening.
reviews.name: Kevin D.

reviews.text: The back door had a gap you could see daylight through. New sweep, new weatherstripping and the strike plate moved a quarter inch. The draft is gone and the door finally latches.
reviews.name: Teresa M.

reviews.text: He mounted a 65-inch TV over our brick fireplace and hid the cables. He checked the brick first, used the right anchors and told me how long it would take before he started.
reviews.name: Brian K.

reviews.text: I had a hole from a doorknob and a long crack over the stairs. You cannot find either one now, and he matched the paint from a can I had in the basement.
reviews.name: Joan P.

reviews.text: I asked for a ceiling light to be swapped for a fan. He said the box would not hold a fan and it needed an electrician, which saved me a problem. He swapped the hall light instead in twenty minutes.
reviews.name: Victor S.

proof.guarantee: If a fix we made does not hold within a year, tell us and we come back to redo it at no charge.
